capabilities: Build routes between waypoints in a block
Generate isochrone reachability polygons around a center point
Read elevation for the points of a track
Snap recorded tracks to the road or path network
Identify the named ways a track follows
disambiguation: Not a stand-alone mapping or routing plugin; it only works as a provider installed alongside Places.
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; usage examples live in a separate sandbox rather than the README.
intentEvidence: This is not a stand-alone plugin, to use, install along side Places.
problem: The Places plugin needs a routing engine to build routes, isochrones, and track analysis, and Valhalla is not available out of the box.
